system.description:
An extremely protective and dense layer of sand surrounds you and takes on the same texture and color of your clothes, skin and item blending in with your clothing perfectly. For the duration of this jutsu you gain 16 Temporary Hit Points. These Temporary Hit Points are resistant to Piercing, Slashing, Bludgeoning and Cold damage as the sand protects you. If you would take Lightning damage, this jutsu is dispelled, ending all of its benefits before calculating damage normally.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the Temporary Hit points by 8.
